$comment: Machine-readable verification record. Regenerate by running the commands below and updating the results. Every status here was produced by actually running the command, not by inspection.

categories.name: Formatting
categories.detail: Prettier reports all matched files conform.
categories.notes: docs/PRODUCT-SPECIFICATION.md and SETUP-CHECKLIST.md are excluded from formatting as user-authored documents.

categories.name: Linting
categories.detail: ESLint 9.39.5 flat config, next/core-web-vitals + next/typescript. Zero errors, zero warnings.
categories.notes: ESLint is pinned to the 9.x line. See knownIssues.eslint-major-pin.

categories.name: Type checking
categories.detail: tsc --noEmit clean under strict mode with noUncheckedIndexedAccess enabled.

categories.name: Coverage
categories.detail: Lines 66.92%, branches 86.61%, functions 81.60%. All above configured thresholds (60/70/60).
categories.notes: Thresholds are a floor to catch accidentally-deleted tests, not a target. The deterministic core in src/core/ sits far above them; uncovered files are wiring modules (registry, factories, barrels) exercised indirectly.

categories.name: Production build
categories.detail: Next.js 16 production build succeeds. 4 static routes prerendered, /api/health dynamic.

categories.name: End-to-end smoke tests
categories.detail: 26 tests passing across desktop and mobile viewports: app shell, skip link, 404, health endpoint, PWA manifest and icons, service worker, offline page, security headers.
categories.notes: Verified with PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chrome against locally installed Chrome. Playwright's bundled browser binary could not be downloaded in this environment. See knownIssues.playwright-browser-download.

categories.name: Accessibility
categories.detail: axe-core reports zero violations against wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a and wcag21aa in both desktop and mobile viewports.
categories.notes: This check found and led to fixing a real dark-mode contrast failure in status badges (2.04:1 against a 4.5:1 requirement). axe is a floor, not proof of accessibility; manual keyboard and screen-reader testing has not been performed.

categories.name: Security baseline
categories.detail: CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy asserted present. X-Powered-By absent. Health endpoint asserted to contain no connection string or key-shaped value.
categories.notes: Baseline only. Authentication, rate limiting, CSRF protection and audit logging are not implemented. See docs/security.md section 9.

categories.name: Dependency audit
categories.detail: No high or critical advisories in production dependencies.
categories.notes: WARN rather than PASS because this was verified locally only. A git remote (origin) is now configured, but the workflow in .github/workflows/ci.yml has not yet run in a real runner.

categories.name: Continuous integration
categories.detail: .github/workflows/ci.yml defines four jobs: quality, build, e2e and security. Syntax is valid and every command it invokes has been run successfully locally.
categories.notes: The workflow has never executed. A git remote (origin, github.com/Inszert/VOYAGR.git) is configured, so the blocker is now only that no push has triggered a run. This becomes PASS after the first green run.

categories.name: Database layer
categories.detail: Repository interfaces defined and fully implemented in memory. Postgres schema written (src/db/migrations/0001_init.sql) with a migration runner.
categories.notes: The SQL has never been executed against a live PostgreSQL instance, and no Postgres implementation of the repositories exists yet. Intentional for this stage; verify when Phase 1.4 lands.

categories.name: Background jobs
categories.detail: In-process driver fully implemented and tested: delays, retries with exponential backoff, deduplication, stats, deterministic drain.
categories.notes: The BullMQ driver is not implemented. Selecting it is a hard error rather than a silent fallback, which is verified by inspection but not by a test against real Redis.

categories.name: AI boundary
categories.detail: 19 tests covering schema validation, cross-field rules, deterministic budget conversion, invented-figure detection and graceful degradation.
categories.notes: Verified against the deterministic mock provider only. No live model has been run through these guardrails; prompt-injection resistance is untested against a real LLM.

categories.name: PWA foundation
categories.detail: Manifest valid and served, all three declared icons served as real PNGs, service worker served with a must-revalidate policy, offline page renders.
categories.notes: Service worker registration and runtime caching behaviour have not been exercised in a browser — the worker is disabled in development by design, and the E2E suite asserts the file is served rather than that it installs and caches. Install-to-homescreen and push delivery are untested.

categories.name: Manual change review
categories.detail: All created and modified files inspected before completion. No existing file was deleted or overwritten; docs/PRODUCT-SPECIFICATION.md and SETUP-CHECKLIST.md are untouched. Git history preserved. The bootstrap was subsequently reviewed and committed as f9b7cba.

knownIssues.summary: ESLint pinned to the 9.x line, which upstream marks end-of-life.
knownIssues.cause: eslint-config-next@16.3.5 bundles an eslint-plugin-react version that calls a context API removed in ESLint 10, producing 'contextOrFilename.getFilename is not a function'.
knownIssues.impact: Development-only dependency; not in the production dependency tree.
knownIssues.resolution: Upgrade when Next.js ships ESLint 10 support.

knownIssues.summary: Playwright's bundled Chromium and ffmpeg could not be downloaded in this environment.
knownIssues.cause: The Playwright CDN was unreachable (repeated TLS timeouts).
knownIssues.impact: None on assertions. The suite was verified against locally installed Chrome via PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chrome. Video capture is opt-in via PLAYWRIGHT_VIDEO=1 since it needs the missing ffmpeg.
knownIssues.resolution: Run 'npx playwright install chromium' on a machine with CDN access. CI installs it normally.

knownIssues.summary: Content-Security-Policy allows 'unsafe-inline' for scripts and styles.
knownIssues.cause: Next.js streaming style and script injection currently requires it.
knownIssues.resolution: Move to a nonce-based CSP before handling payments or authenticated mutations.

requiresUserAction: Push to origin so GitHub Actions runs for the first time; the workflow is still unproven in a real runner.
Run 'npx playwright install chromium' on a network that can reach the Playwright CDN, to use bundled Chromium instead of local Chrome.
Approve the Playwright MCP server in .mcp.json when prompted; project MCP servers are not enabled automatically.
Decide the flight and hotel provider vendors before Phase 1.11.
Decide the LLM vendor before AI explanations go live.
Decide PostgreSQL hosting before Phase 1.4 and Redis hosting before Phase 1.6.
Choose a licence; README records it as not yet chosen.
